claims.text:
Gorhendad is the translation of Westron Ogmandab.. According to Stoor tradition, it used to mean "great-grandfather" or "ancestor".
In an earlier manuscript version the Westron name was Ogforgad.
J.R.R. Tolkien mentioned that he gave the name Gorhendad a "Celtic cast" and that the relation of Welsh or British to English was somewhat similar to the relation of the older language of the Stoors and Bree-men to Westron. He stated that Gorhendad is a "Welsh word meaning 'great-grandfather'".

claims.text: Gorhendad Oldbuck of the Marish crossed the Brandywine in () and founded Buckland and constructed Brandy Hall. In honour of their new land, he changed his family name from Oldbuck (H. Zaragamba) to Brandybuck (H. Brandagamba). He ruled the land as Master of Buckland and Master of the Hall, virtually a small independent country. After his death, the head of the Brandybuck family became the Master of Buckland and Master of the Hall. When he and his family moved from the Shire to Buckland, the office of Thain passed from the Oldbuck family to the Took Family and Isumbras Took I became the first Thain of the Tooks.
